page.title: Reports and KPIs
page.description: Figures are shown in USD, from the stored snapshots.

COLLECTED_BY_MONTH.title: Revenue collected by month
COLLECTED_BY_MONTH.description: Confirmed payment allocations grouped by payment month (USD)

REVENUE_BY_PROJECT.title: Revenue by project
REVENUE_BY_PROJECT.description: Ranking by collected, with the margin

RECEIVABLES_AGING.title: Receivables and aging
RECEIVABLES_AGING.description: Balance per client in 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days past due

ACCOUNT_FLOW.title: Flow by account
ACCOUNT_FLOW.description: Inflows and outflows by account and month

TAXES_REGISTERED.title: Taxes registered
TAXES_REGISTERED.description: VAT billed, withholdings suffered and IGTF recorded by month. Informative only; it does not replace the accounting.

MRR.title: MRR
MRR.description: Σ active recurring charges normalized to a month (quarterly ÷ 3, semiannual ÷ 6, annual ÷ 12)

DSO.title: DSO (days sales outstanding)
DSO.description: (Receivables at close ÷ billed in the period) × days in the period

COLLECTION_RATE.title: Collection rate
COLLECTION_RATE.description: Collected in the period ÷ billed in the period

FIXED_MONTHLY_EXPENSE.title: Fixed monthly expense
FIXED_MONTHLY_EXPENSE.description: Σ active recurring expenses normalized to a month

RUNWAY.title: Runway (months)
RUNWAY.description: Total account balance (USD) ÷ average monthly expense of the last 3 months

REVENUE_CONCENTRATION.title: Revenue concentration
REVENUE_CONCENTRATION.description: % of the amount collected in the last 12 months that comes from the top 1 and top 3 clients

AVG_PROJECT_TICKET.title: Average ticket per project
AVG_PROJECT_TICKET.description: Average contracted value of the projects started in the period

CLIENT_LTV.title: LTV per client
CLIENT_LTV.description: Historical amount collected per client; also its average

NEW_CLIENTS.title: New clients
NEW_CLIENTS.description: Clients that became ACTIVO in the period

PROSPECT_CONVERSION.title: Prospect conversion
PROSPECT_CONVERSION.description: Prospects that became ACTIVO ÷ prospects created (in the period)

AVG_PROJECT_DURATION.title: Average project duration
AVG_PROJECT_DURATION.description: Average of (actual delivery − start) of the delivered projects

ON_TIME_PROJECTS.title: On-time projects
ON_TIME_PROJECTS.description: % of projects delivered on or before the estimated date

DOCUMENT_COVERAGE.title: Document coverage
DOCUMENT_COVERAGE.description: % of active projects with a FIRMADO contract and a current NDA
